name: Citians Butterfly Splash

timeline.event: wordmark visible centered; butterfly starts off-screen left
butterfly enters and begins curved upward flight; wings flap
butterfly turns down toward upper-right of letter S

motion.path: cubic Bezier/S-curve from off-screen left, above wordmark, ending at upper-right of S

integration_notes: Do not add a second static butterfly to the wordmark.

After completion replace splash route with existing Home/Login route.
